description.en: Proactively sends one short message into an active session after configurable idle intervals, gated by quiet hours, an unanswered-message cap and a daily limit; falls back to a system notification plus a log entry.
description.zh: 到点主动开口：按可配置间隔，过安静时段／未回话上限／每日上限等闸门后挑一句投进活跃会话；投不进就发系统通知并写日志。
